In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the telluric line RV measurements are not a reliable proxy for the atmospheric winds.
the precision of the HARPS telluric radial velocity measurements is of the order of 2 m s-1 and is dominated by the precision of the radiosondes.
the precision of the RV of telluric lines is of 1 m s−1.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the RV of the tellurics can be used as an excellent wavelength reference.
the telluric line RVs are sensitive to the wind speed and direction, and to the temperature, but not to the humidity.
the RVs of telluric lines are sensitive to the atmospheric conditions, and the RVs of the tellurics can be used for monitoring the atmosphere.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the RVs of telluric O2 lines are sensitive to the wind speed.
the precision of the RV of the atmospheric lines is limited by the precision of the wavelength calibration.
the telluric line RVs are very sensitive to the wind profile, and this sensitivity is not only dependent on the wind speed but also on its vertical profile.
